Saudi Fair Hiring Audit – Dashboard

CS 476 Ethics in Data Science · 10,000 synthetic applications · four-fifths rule threshold 0.80

Data: output/*.csv from pipeline.py

Hire rate by qualification band and gender (%)

At every qualification level women were hired less often than men. That gap is the bias.

Hire rate by region (%)

Red = below 80% of the best region (adverse impact).

Hire rate by job family and gender (%)

Scorecard (test set, 3,000 applicants; every model shortlists 35.4%)

Impact ratio by model (≥ 0.80 passes)

Fairness vs accuracy

Moving right (fairer) costs almost no AUC.

Selection rate and recall of qualified applicants by group

Recall of qualified = share of truly qualified people the model selects. Equal recall = equal opportunity.

What drives the score (top 10 features)

Red = sensitive attribute or proxy. Logistic regression: |standardised coefficient|; gradient boosting: permutation importance.

How well each feature reveals a group (AUC)

0.5 = reveals nothing · above 0.7 = high proxy risk.

Applicants (test set)

All data is synthetic. Results support, never replace, human hiring decisions.
